name: Neubrutalism
summary: Neubrutalism (also spelt Neo Brutalism , and alternatively referred to as Neo Memphis ) is a design aesthetic that focuses on breaking the traditional conventions of design by using unconventional visual elements, such as contrasting color palettes and grotesque typefaces.
